all-docker.database: dedicated local PostgreSQL database and role
all-docker.internalStorage: persistent local volume mounted read-write at /app/storage
all-docker.controlPlane: internal HTTP with Basic Auth behind the HTTPS edge
all-docker.workerPath: Kestra calls the independent worker service on its internal endpoint

hybrid.database: dedicated district PostgreSQL database and role
hybrid.databaseTransport: verified TLS with district CA trust
hybrid.internalStorage: district shared filesystem mounted read-write at /app/storage
hybrid.workerPath: Kestra calls every independent worker endpoint through verified HTTPS

kubernetes.process: one standalone pod with one replica
kubernetes.databaseTransport: verified TLS with Kubernetes Secret based CA trust
kubernetes.internalStorage: ReadWriteMany persistent volume mounted read-write at /app/storage
kubernetes.controlPlane: ClusterIP HTTPS service with Basic Auth
kubernetes.workerPath: Kestra calls independent worker services through verified cluster HTTPS

shared.authentication: Basic Auth from the profile secret reference
shared.telemetry: server and UI anonymous usage disabled
